mentions.name: Business Web App Rewrite
mentions.description: A rewrite of a web app used in the author's business, rebuilt on the author's own JavaScript framework, which made the app much faster. Work currently focuses on adding tests to the rewritten app.
mentions.problem: The original version of the app was slower; rewriting it with a custom JavaScript framework made it much faster.
mentions.audience: A web app the author uses in their own business.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on tests for a rewrite of a web app I use in my business. I rewrote to use my own JavaScript framework and things are much faster now.
